title: List Price of an In-Home PAP Therapy Equipment Unit by Rental Coverage Status
content:
# List Price of an In-Home PAP Therapy Equipment Unit by Rental Coverage Status

**Pricing schedule.** When a patient buys outright the PAP Therapy Equipment unit that stands in their home on a coverage-billed device record, the list price follows the coverage the unit was rented under:

- while the coverage record on the device record is **active**, the unit is sold at the class's charge for a rented device not returned;
- when that coverage record has **terminated**, the unit is sold at the average of that charge and the class's self-pay retail price — the two added together and divided by 2 — rounded half up to the cent;
- on any other record, the list price is the class's self-pay retail price.

**The sale at list price.** For a unit bought outright where it already stands in the patient's home on a coverage-billed device record, and only for such a unit, the unit is sold at its list price, paid in full by the patient when the sale is booked, with no delivery fee; every other outright purchase remains at the class's self-pay retail price plus its self-pay delivery fee, paid in full when the order is placed, as the base self-pay rule states.

**Where it is read.** The coverage record is the one the PAP Therapy Equipment device record names as its coverage; its status — active, terminated, or another status such as pending verification or not eligible — is read from the patient's Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility records.

## List prices by class (USD, from the class figures)

| Device class | Coverage record active | Coverage record terminated | Any other status |
|---|---|---|---|
| CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601) | 650.00 | 699.50 | 749.00 |
| Auto-Adjusting CPAP System (E0601) | 750.00 | 824.50 | 899.00 |
| Bilevel PAP Spontaneous System (E0470) | 1400.00 | 1625.00 | 1850.00 |
| Bilevel PAP Spontaneous-Timed System (E0471) | 3200.00 | 3700.00 | 4200.00 |
| Adaptive Servo-Ventilation System (E0471) | 3900.00 | 4750.00 | 5600.00 |

**Worked figure.** Auto-Adjusting CPAP System (E0601), coverage record terminated: 750.00 plus 899.00 is 1649.00; divided by 2 is 824.50.
